risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have sensor/shutter/autofocus faults
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, display lighting up, and a test shot being taken and reviewed

risks.risk: LCD screen could be cracked, scratched, or have dead pixels (screen shown closed/folded in photo 1)
risks.proof: Photo of screen opened and displaying a live image or menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen possibly damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Unknown shutter actuation count, which heavily affects DSLR resale value
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EOSInfo/ShutterCount software
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count, worst case

risks.risk: Lens optics could have fungus, haze, or scratched elements not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements held up to light

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of battery, charger, and any included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or damage not visible without lens removed
risks.proof: Photo of camera body with lens detached showing the sensor
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown, worst case

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing live view/display, and firing the shutter
Photo of the screen opened and displaying an image or menu
Screenshot or photo of shutter count from camera settings
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements against light
Photo of included battery, charger, and memory card
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identified from the body badge and lens markings, and while functionality, screen condition, shutter count, and lens optics are unverified, these can be priced at worst case using photographed cosmetic condition alone.
